name: doge_alignment
short: D&D alignment chart for your server
description: Slash commands to put yourself (and others) on a server's 3x3 D&D alignment chart, with alignment admins who can move anyone.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores your alignment, display name and avatar URL for each server's chart, and whether you are an alignment admin there. /alignment_remove takes you off a chart; Red's data deletion removes you everywhere.
